Important
Hostinger includes a 30-day money-back guarantee on all hosting plans, so you can test the platform before fully committing.
Other costs of owning a website
Domain registration, SSL, customization, ecommerce tools, and marketing software all add to the cost of building a website. How much each adds depends on your project and which of these your hosting plan already covers.
Domain name
A domain name adds around $10–$25/year to your website costs, depending on the extension.

excerpts.title: How much does website hosting cost in 2026? Price overview
excerpts.text:
Website hosting costs range from $2 to $500/month, depending on the type of hosting you choose. Shared hosting, which is the most affordable option for new websites, starts at $2–$10/month. VPS hosting runs $10–$100/month for dedicated resources and root access.
Cloud hosting costs $10–$200/month and runs across a multi-server network built for reliability. Dedicated hosting starts at $80/month for a full physical server. WordPress hosting runs at $3–$25/month for standard plans, with managed options reaching $200/month.
Domain registration, SSL, customization tools, ecommerce features, and marketing software all add to the total, though many plans bundle some of these at no extra charge.
